PDF A Survey of Octree Volume Rendering Methods
1 Introduction An octree is a hierarchical binary decomposition of 3-space along its component axes. A conventional octree guarantees regular, non-overlapping node spacing, thus is well-suited as a container for rectilinear scalar field data.
